config.category.banner_warning: Changes take effect immediately for Actions (config is re-read per message) and on next process restart for Dispatcher, MQ, and Beacon infra (config is read once at process start). This dashboard has no login — anyone with network access to it can change live pipeline behavior and provider credentials.
config.group_form.wiring_confirm: This changes MQTT topic/event wiring — a mistake here can silently break a pipeline. Save anyway?
config.import_export.title: Import / Export config
config.import_export.intro: A JSON snapshot of everything under {config_code} — settings overrides, transmit policies, source display names, and every adapter definition. Secrets ({key1}, {key2}) are never included. Import only creates or updates by name/source — it never deletes anything already on this install that's absent from the file.
config.import_export.export_desc: Download the current config as a JSON file.
config.import_export.import_desc: Upload a file produced by Export above (or by {script_code}) to preview what would change before anything is written — nothing is applied until you confirm on the next page.
config.import_preview.title: Preview import
config.import_preview.intro: Nothing has been written yet — this is a dry run. Review below, then confirm to actually apply it. Existing settings/adapters/policies/sources sharing a key with the file will be overwritten; nothing already on this install that's absent from the file is touched.
config.import_preview.skipped_warning: {count} CUSTOM adapter(s) in this file will be skipped — enable {link} on this install to import them. Their Python code is never read or executed either way.
config.import_preview.custom_warning: This file contains {count} CUSTOM adapter(s) — operator-authored Python, executed with no sandboxing on every poll once imported. Review each one below before confirming.
config.import_preview.truncated_note: … (truncated — the full code is what will actually be stored)
config.import_preview.confirm_custom_cod: I have reviewed the Python code above and accept the risk of executing operator-authored code with no sandboxing.
config.import_preview.confirm_overwrite_: I understand this will overwrite existing settings/adapters/policies/sources sharing a name with this file.
config.import_preview.nothing_to_apply: Nothing in this file would create or update anything on this install.
config.import_result.title: Import complete
config.import_result.applied_banner: Import applied — settings/adapters/policies/sources shown as "created" or "updated" below are now live; nothing else on this install was touched.
config.rf_conf.editor_disabled: Disabled. Set {var} to {val} above to edit {filename} from here.
config.rf_conf.no_login_warning: This dashboard has no login. Anyone who can reach it can overwrite {conf_path}. A timestamped .bak is written on every save. Nothing is restarted — after saving, run {restart_cmd} on the host.
config.rf_conf.read_only_warning: The UI process can't write {conf_path} — this is read-only.
